description: This PHP source file defines a controller class Restore related to system restore tasks within the Opencart admin module. It contains methods for initiating and processing database restore operations, including validating input, managing tasks, file handling, and executing SQL commands. The class interacts with configuration, language, model, and database components of the framework.

classes.name: Restore
classes.description: Controller class for handling system restore tasks, including starting the restore process and reading/restoring SQL dump files, with validation and task scheduling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initiates a restore task by validating the filename, checking file existence, and scheduling a restore read task with maintenance mode enabled.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Performs the actual reading and execution of SQL commands from a backup file, with safeguards against certain tables, progress tracking, and rescheduling if necessary.
